original_target.title: Minimax estimation of topic distributions with weak sparsity

scope_comparison: The final 2026 JMLR Theorem 19 and section 5 retain upper bounds and explicitly leave the minimax-optimal l1 rate under assumption (15) open. Ordered-decay weak sparsity differs from support-size sparsity; vertex-hunting algorithm conditions differ from parameter-class restrictions. High-probability bounds are not silently converted to expected-risk matching bounds.

primary_sources.locator: Theorem 19 pages 14–15, section 5 page 33; published May 2026
